jobs.title: Senior Manager, Coach & Instructor Enablement
jobs.description: Every team has AI. Few have mastered it. Humans were built to adapt, but AI is now moving faster than most workforces can. Multiverse is the AI adoption layer: the missing link between the AI tools that companies have invested in and the people expected to use them. Our ambition is to put AI capability in every worker’s hands. Apprenticeships got us started: we’ve trained over a third of the UK’s data and AI apprentices, worked with a third of the FTSE 100, and generated £2bn+ in verified ROI. Now Mastry, our new adaptive learning platform, takes that further, guiding a company’s AI workforce transformation from start to finish. Mae, our AI guide inside Mastry, is a real-time AI agent that thinks, speaks, listens and sees, working alongside the tools you already use, like Claude and Copilot. We closed our latest fundraising round in April 2026, with $500m+ raised in total from VC partners including Index Ventures, General Catalyst, Schroders Capital and Lightspeed. With a $2.1bn valuation, we are Europe’s first EdTech double unicorn, and we are just getting started. If you want to shape how the workforce wins in the AI era, come and join us. Senior Manager, Coach & Instructor Enablement FTC 14 months Coach & Instructor Enablement exists to make the delivery organisation measurably better at retaining learners and delivering successful outcomes consistently, predictably and at scale. You will enhance our existing strategy and lead the team through its exciting next stage of growth. The team will form around four capability pillars and a new Enablement Operations platform. You will be building that structure while it delivers across a large delivery organisation that supports thousands of learners. Priorities will shift underneath you as delivery data moves, and part of the job is deciding what starts, what stops, and most importantly what must not slip. jobs.title: Senior z/OS Mainframe Trainer / Lead Instructor (f/m/d) | remote
jobs.description: We are looking for an experienced z/OS Mainframe Trainer to deliver an intensive Mainframe Academy designed to prepare the next generation of mainframe professionals for careers in complex enterprise IT environments. The Academy covers essential IBM Mainframe technologies, with a strong focus on z/OS system programming, mainframe operations and enterprise infrastructure. Key Responsibilities Prepare and deliver structured, interactive and practice-oriented training sessions. Teach core z/OS concepts and mainframe system programming. Cover key topics such as z/OS architecture, JCL/JES, Data Management, SMP/E, IPL, CICS, DB2, IMS, MQ, System Automation and REXX. Develop training materials, practical exercises and hands-on labs. Mentor participants and support them throughout the programme. Guide participants through a final practical project. Required Experience and Skills Extensive hands-on experience with IBM z/OS and Mainframe technologies. Strong background in z/OS system programming or mainframe infrastructure. Broad knowledge of mainframe technologies and enterprise environments. Previous experience in technical training, workshops or mentoring. Excellent communication and presentation skills. Ability to deliver engaging training sessions in English. Program Details Kick-off event: 11 January 2027 – on-site in Stockholm, Sweden Training period: 8 February – 30 April 2027 Workload: Full-time engagement during the training period Location: Primarily remote, with selected on-site days in Stockholm, Sweden Language: English Preparation: Dedicated and remunerated preparation time will be scheduled in addition to the training days, allowing sufficient time to develop training materials, prepare exercises and set up practical learning activities. If you have extensive IBM z/OS experience and enjoy teaching and mentoring the next generation of Mainframe professionals, we would be delighted to hear from you. jobs.title: Senior Channel Enablement Manager
jobs.description: Fastly helps people stay better connected with the things they love. Fastly’s edge cloud platform enables customers to create great digital experiences quickly, securely, and reliably by processing, serving, and securing our customers’ applications as close to their end-users as possible — at the edge of the Internet. The platform is designed to take advantage of the modern internet, to be programmable, and to support agile software development. Fastly’s customers include many of the world’s most prominent companies, including GitHub, Yelp, Paramount, and JetBlue. We're building a more trustworthy Internet. Come join us. Posting Open Date: 8/18/2026 Anticipated Posting Close Date*: 10/30/2026 *Job posting may close early due to the volume of applicants. Senior Channel Enablement Manager As a Senior Channel Enablement Manager at Fastly, you will drive the strategy and delivery that arms our global partner ecosystem and Channel Account Managers with the ultimate competitive edge. You’ll serve as one of the primary architects behind our channel success, creating high-impact enablement content, delivering engaging virtual sessions, and seamlessly executing end-to-end enablement program logistics. Embedded within a highly collaborative team, you will partner closely with Channel Marketing, Operations, and Program Management to build a cohesive growth engine. Your work directly accelerates Fastly’s market reach and revenue by turning complex technology into actionable selling strategies for our partners. By empowering the people who power our platform's growth, you will play a pivotal role in scaling our footprint and defining the future of the edge. jobs.title: AI Trainer - Video Annotation
jobs.description: AI Trainer - Video Annotation Remote | Independent Contractor Prove your skills. Get certified. Robotics AI is advancing rapidly, and high-quality video data helps intelligent systems better understand the world around them. We are inviting detail-oriented professionals to complete our certification process for potential robotics AI projects. ▌ What you will do As part of the certification process, you will demonstrate your ability to: Annotate short video clips by identifying objects, actions and events. Evaluate video quality, relevance and accuracy against established guidelines. Assess the clarity and plausibility of movements. Apply instructions consistently and identify potential quality issues. ▌ What you bring Strong attention to detail and analytical thinking. Strong written English and the ability to follow detailed instructions independently. A commitment to accuracy and consistency. No previous AI or robotics experience required. ▌ What the work looks like You may review short videos and be asked to tag objects or actions, rate video clarity or camera angles on a 1 to 10 scale, or assess whether movements are clearly visible and plausible. Please note: We currently have three projects open, and completing the certification process will allow us to evaluate which project may be the best fit for you.
